title: SOMA (FULL GAME)
confidence_note: principles at game level, not frame-accurate timestamps

observations.observation: Underwater station = pressure doors, bulkheads, pump/generator machinery, corroded metal, emergency lighting. Machinery rooms dominate.
Existential dread + absence. Monster encounters are sparse and earned; most tension is atmosphere and sound.
Slow quiet exploration punctuated by brief intense danger; ambient creaks and distant machinery set mood.
Environmental storytelling through logs and the decay of a place people lived and fled.
